title: Nintendo announces two consecutive Directs for September, including one dedicated to Zelda's 40th anniversary
summary: The company confirmed presentations on September 8 and 9, with a special event focused on the legendary Link saga.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: mods remove timer and patch fixes technical errors
summary: Players modify the RPG to remove time pressure while Rebel Wolves releases updates to improve stability.

title: Miami-Dade Police reject collaboration with GTA 6 and denounce that the game glorifies crime
summary: The sheriff and local authorities oppose turning parts of the city into Vice City, claiming it contradicts their daily work.

title: The White House launches a Tetris clone with racist content; Tetris Company and media denounce infringement
summary: The official website published modified arcade games with hate messages, prompting legal responses and criticism.

title: Gamescom apologizes for blaming indie developers after hardware thefts at the event
summary: The organization acknowledged its insensitive response and promised to improve security following widespread criticism.

title: Exodus, the spiritual successor to Mass Effect, impresses in first impressions with zero-gravity combat
summary: Journalists highlight familiarity with the BioWare saga but praise romance mechanics and space exploration.

title: DLSS 5 arrives on AMD cards and sparks debate over its performance impact in NBA 2K27 and No Man's Sky
summary: Nvidia's new technology shows drops of up to 73% in FPS in some cases, while developers express concern.

title: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $13 billion to strengthen its bet on open-source AI
summary: The purchase aims to integrate open models into Nvidia's ecosystem and accelerate generative AI development.

title: Xbox imposes monthly limits on Game Pass Cloud Gaming to ensure reliability and performance
summary: The cloud streaming service will restrict usage hours, though the company assures it will affect only a minority of players.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds shows trailer for its major expansion Ascendance with improvements for Dual Blades
summary: Capcom reveals massive new content including enhanced action mechanics and more monsters.

title: Tim Schafer celebrates Double Fine's independence from Xbox and announces the chaotic Thank You Bus Driver
summary: The studio regains its creative freedom and presents a bus driving game with absurd humor.

title: Civilization 7 can be played for free for a limited time on PC to celebrate Labor Day
summary: Firaxis' strategy game is available at no cost for a few days to attract new players after its launch.

title: Dungeons & Dragons will have a Netflix series about the vampire Strahd with the director of The Prisoner of Azkaban
summary: The platform will adapt the horror setting Ravenloft with Alfonso Cuarón as executive producer.

title: PAX expands its presence with a new tabletop show in Texas and PAX Unplugged in Houston for 2027
summary: Organizers aim to win back fans in the southern U.S. with events focused on tabletop games.

title: GTA 6 drives a 30% increase in PS5 and Xbox console sales in the UK
summary: The Netflix trailer and general hype drive hardware demand ahead of the game's launch.
